programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The girls find some turtle eggs on Dolphin City beach: they are too fragile to move, so they take turns watching over them till they hatch. But that's not counting with Miriam and Zane – who are having a beach party!! Meanwhile, underwater, Bernie, cannot bear all the noise and disruption his neighbors are making, and decides to leave his cave and go and stay elsewhere for a bit of a rest.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The White Mermaid is in danger! Her sanctuary, the sunken galleon of Edward the Cruel, is about to be discovered by Stanley Finch, the famous explorer. The girls decide to stop him, and make his boat take another course, towards the sinister underwater stone circle.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: After being carried by a current into the underwater stone circle, Rikki is victim of a terrible spell: she cannot turn back into a human! To break the spell, she has to wait for the full moon – in three days’ time!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Bay prepares for a great excitement: there's soon to be the first great robotics competition organized by the Dolphin City University. The events will take place underwater, and Lewis wants badly to win first prize: enrolment in the Science Faculty! Unfortunately, Zane is also participating, and true to form, can only do it by cheating.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s kid brother Elliott happened to see Rikki’s mermaid tail in the water! He starts telling everyone he’s seen a sea monster. To cover up, the girls and Lewis start building a fake monster, to make people think it was all a hoax. But it’s too late – the whole town’s out looking for the famous “Dolphin City Monster”.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Vandals are carrying out a nasty plan: they have enlisted a terrible horde of stinging jellyfish to sow terror in the Bay. But the mermaids aren’t able to respond: Rikki grounded, wrongly accused of calling in a fire alarm at school, and Cleo has to help care for swimmers stung by the jellies.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A lunar eclipse makes Cleo lose her power!! Lewis tries to get it back using scientific methods, but he runs into a lot of trouble! Meanwhile, Teddy the kid turtle has got into trouble with Bernie and the other animals in the Bay after playing too many practical jokes.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The famous explorer Stanley Finch, is back in Dolphin City, with an amazing hi-tech mini-submarine. He’s decided, this time, to find Edward the Cruel’s sunken galleon. Lewis gets enrolled as Stanley’s assistant in the little submarine, and tries to stop him. But he triggers an accident.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: To help their friend Cleo get hired (as a volunteer) at the Dolphin City Oceanic Centre, Rikki, Emma and Lewis take her out free-diving off Mako Island, to see underwater wildlife in person! But when their motorboat’s engine fails, they have to spend the night on the island: that night, when Rikki, Emma and Cleo are exploring the island, they fall into a mysterious cave.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Little Elliot gets his big sister Emma to enter the Grand Sand Sculpture contest with him. Meanwhile Cleo’s day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor’s daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! Lewis discovers it’s the figurehead of a famous pirate galleon, the White Mermaid, which sank at sea without a trace! Rikki and Emma are thrilled, while Cleo is preoccupied by something else.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane’s father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren’t going to let this happen!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it’s like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma, Rikki and Cleo are teenage girls with a secret - they’re still mermaids. They’re handling life pretty well but the threat of the full moon, and the strange effects it has on mermaids, looms. This time Lewis is certain he can help but things go awry and the girls are moonstruck.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo uses her mermaid powers to avoid a sprinkler and inadvertently splashes Charlotte, the new girl at school. Lewis and Charlotte meet and it’s clear she likes him straight away. With the girls’ mermaid powers turned up to max, Lewis tries his best to help but his attempts only cause Cleo to feel crowded by him.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. Although he believes she’s not a mermaid anymore, things are still tense between them. Rikki assures Emma she can handle Zane; they broke up and that’s all there is to it. As Zane continues to try to win Rikki’s affections, he realises she’s still a mermaid and saves her from the threat of discovery.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit by messing up the order of things. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Meanwhile Lewis wants to know why Cleo broke up with him; concerned that he’s not masculine enough for her.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo notes that Don seems to be down since her mother left. Later, Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls, supposed to grant wishes. Cleo instantly thinks it could help get Don and her Mum back together. They make the potion and it doesn’t seem to work.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Life isn’t the same at Cleo’s house since her mother left. When it appears that Don has a girlfriend - Cleo and Kim are horrified, thinking this means a step-mother. Meanwhile, Charlotte is making more moves on Lewis, making Cleo increasingly jealous. Don organises a dinner and Cleo is shocked to find her Dad’s new partner is Charlotte’s mother!

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: As ZOEY, KIKI and AMBER head out to the Benedict cane field, owned by BRANDON and LUCA’s family, ZOEY is excited.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: With LUCA and BRANDON dangerously close to their secret, KIKI feels that they have no choice but to stick close to them, to find out what they really know.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: ZOEY is sick of waiting and decides to take charge of finding a way home. Back at the cane field, ZOEY and AMBER test out the energy field one more time.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: When a storm is forecast to hit Lightning Point, ZOEY and KIKI know it’s time – they can send a signal through the lightning, via the energy field and back to Lumina.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Despite Kuru's warning that love and magic don't mix, Alex tricks him to tell her a spell to prove if Marcus, who asked her on a band date, loves her. It turns her into a frog, which can only be undone by a kiss from a true lover.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Vashan magically enables his trusted servant Diva to transform into butterfly, to ride inconspicuously on the elephant Anala to the 'old' world, and into a blond babe to spy on the princess there. After witnessing Alex's clumsy magic practice on Kuru, 'Juliet' enrolls at school.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports diplomatically to Omar about Alex's slow progress and Devi to Vashan that she's still a magically clumsy brat living a commoner's life, the rival prince allows her to return as butterfly and seduce Kuru as Juliet, so he'll cease being her only good influence.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru accidentally breaks JD's cymbal, but pays for it with a golden coin from Manjipoor worth the eightfold, which he spends on flashy clothes. The Wilsons see Kuru gets rewarded too. When Alex flippantly calls his allowance excessive, he dutifully begs the council to reduce it, which is nearly considered treason for questioning one of its decisions.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Shannon is worried about the wolves and their safety; now people know they exist, they may be hunted. She plans to inform the Department of the Environment so they can protect the wolves, but first needs proof that the wolves exist and she knows how to get it - Carl’s wolfbait! Maddy and Rhydian are worried, they have to get the bait before Shannon gets her hands on it.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Rhydian unexpectedly returns on the night of the full moon, chased by wild wolfbloods as Tom discovers Shannon spying on the Smiths with a surveillance camera hidden in the Den. Maddy’s overjoyed to have Rhydian back and persuades her parents to help him re-adjust back to life in Stoneybridge.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Maddy finds a strange girl stealing her school clothes from the washing line. The thief turns on Maddy. It’s a wolfblood! Maddy gives chase but Rhydian stops her, recognising the girl as Jana, daughter of Alric. Maddy is shocked to see Jana arrive at school the next day with her uniform on, greeting Rhydian like a long lost “friend”.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Liam’s dad, a farmer, has ploughed up an old skeleton of a wolfblood in mid-transformation – and Liam is boasting about his ancestor being a werewolf hunter. Our Wolfbloods go to investigate. Jana is livid, telling tells the others they have a duty to give it the traditional wolfblood burial.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: It’s a lunar eclipse, and Jana is bursting with excitement! This is the ultimate night for Wolfbloods, one where their wolf and their human are finally at one. They become a wolf on the inside, whist remaining - for an hour - human on the outside, apart from veining and yellow eyes. It’s a buzz! Jana invites Rhydian to spend the eclipse with her on the moors, but Rhydian isn’t sure.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Jana, on her way to school, is surprised by Alric. Far from being terrified she flings herself into his arms. Jana hadn't been banished from the pack at all. Alric had sent her in to lure Rhydian into coming back with her. She has taken too long. He wants all three of them to return by the end of the day. In school, Tom is humiliated by Jimi showing off his judo in the gym.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the cafe. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: The girls discover the Mako crystals contain immense energy and need to mount a rescue mission when Zane jealously steals one in an effort to gain Rikki's attention.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: The girls sit their final school exams and have to avoid a water attack in public when the full moon rises early.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Bella's eager to ask Will to the end of year party until she sees him asking Rikki. A big misunderstanding occurs which prompts Will to express his true feelings for Bella.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Don gets a second job at the Marine Park on the Pirate ship and outshines Cleo, threatening the future of her Dolphin show.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: To help their friend Cleo get hired (as a volunteer) at the Dolphin City Oceanic Centre, Rikki, Emma and Lewis take her out free-diving off Mako Island, to see underwater wildlife in person! But when their motorboat’s engine fails, they have to spend the night on the island: that night, when Rikki, Emma and Cleo are exploring the island, they fall into a mysterious cave.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1

Meanwhile Cleo’s day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor’s daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1

The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories

programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one’s pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Atanasio y Graciela se quedan helados y comienzan a decir y a pensar cosas para que Gisela no se entere ni se de cuenta de nada. Yubiri está super avergonzada por lo que pasó con Atanasio. Juan Diego le dice que lo que pasa es que Atanasio es muy correcto y como el fue novio de Carolina. Graciela se despide y Gisela le dice que irá por la oficina para ayudarla. Atanasio le dice que no cree que haya ido por trabajo sino para decirle algo a su esposa. Dionisia y Lolita llegan al apartamento.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Margot advierte a Manuela sobre Benjamín, mientras Alejandro investiga a Néstor Cordido. Elizabeth y Moisés descubren que son hermanos y buscan ayuda en Manuela. Marcelo recibe un ascenso pero enfrenta crisis familiar tras ser descubierto con su amante. Benjamín planea apoderarse de la fortuna Tariffi, lo que lleva a Margot a pedir protección para su hija. Mientras tanto, Celia ruega a sus hijos permanecer unidos, y María del Pilar duda entre Marcelo y Gustavo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro pide a José Luis que lleve a Rosa para enfrentarla y reclamarle haberlo engañado. Adolfo descubre por Amalia toda la mentira de Rosalía. Isaías, borracho, es asaltado por malandros confabulados con el taxista y queda tirado en la calle. Natalia revela a Eustoquio que Erasto no es su padrino sino su padre, dejándolo en shock. Carmen encuentra a Rosa furiosa y la manda a dormir. Eustoquio interroga a Arminda quien queda muda. Erasto se obsesiona con destruir a Adolfo para quedarse con Consuelo. Chencha aconseja a Blanca investigar la familia de Arminda buscando a la hija.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca aparece cuando lo están llevando preso a Leo y culpa a María Lucía de que él este en problemas, a lo que Trinidad decide irse enojada de la casa junto con Anzola. Cuando estaban saliendo se encontraron con Oriana, quién muy enojada, le dice a Trinidad que Leo le juró que iba a cambiar y que iba a estar con ella, pero Trinidad le dice que este le envió una carta de amor muy importante a su nieta. Leonardo no puede entender cómo es que Irene tuvo un hijo con Felipe y la razón por la cuál ella no lo deja acercarse a Mateo. Irene, enojada, le pide que por favor deje de meterse en su vida privada. Justo en ese momento Rebeca lo llama por teléfono para contarle lo sucedido con Leo, y él planea enfrentar a Alejandra para que saque la denuncia en su contra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro confirma que no es hermano de Sol y le pide al Médico que le dé un papel donde conste esto. Alejandro increpa a Madroño en la cárcel y este lo apuñala pero la herida es leve y Alejandro no lo delata. Al fin del día Alejandro recibe el pale que tanto esperaba donde consta que él y Sol no son hermanos. Giselle y Bárbara están celosas de Miyogla. Ricarda compra un billete ganador de lotería para respaldar el hecho de que tiene ahora mucho dinero.
